f0001.note: Kept separate from the writeTemplateData crash above. Different method (processVue rather than writeTemplateData), different failure mode (a toBe assertion expecting "false", not a TypeError), and no shared frame. Both are in DruxtDocgen and a single refactor could plausibly have broken both, but "same class, same commit" is not "same cause", and nothing in the payload links them.
